description: Defines the NextcloudAPI interface for interacting with Nextcloud notes, including methods for CRUD operations and capabilities retrieval, along with extension functions for specific API calls.

classes.name: NextcloudAPI
classes.description: Retrofit interface defining API endpoints for Nextcloud notes and capabilities.

methods.name: getNotesAPI
methods.description: Fetches a list of notes from Nextcloud.

methods.name: getNoteAPI
methods.description: Fetches a single note by URL.

methods.name: createNoteAPI
methods.description: Creates a new note in Nextcloud.

methods.name: updateNoteAPI
methods.description: Updates an existing note in Nextcloud.

methods.name: getNotesCapabilities
methods.description: Extension function to get notes capabilities from Nextcloud.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note given its ID.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by ID.
